meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 拥有操作真实浏览器的能力。它会按你的指令打开网页、点击或填入元素、滚动、截图、读取页面文字与链接,再把操作结果反馈给你。
howto.when: 当你要求操作真实浏览器时触发,典型如打开网页、填写表单、截图,其他网页自动化需求同理。

say.text: 打开 example.com,读取页面标题告诉我。
say.note: 会打开该网页并返回标题文本。

say.text: 在登录页输入用户名和密码,然后点登录。
say.note: 定位输入框填入内容并点击登录按钮。

say.text: 截取当前网页全貌,存成一张图片。
say.note: 对整页截图并保存文件。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can drive a real browser through CLI commands: open pages, click and fill elements, scroll, take screenshots, read page text/URLs, then report results back.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to operate a real browser, such as opening a page, filling forms, taking screenshots, or similar web automation tasks.

say_en.text: Open example.com and tell me the page title.
say_en.note: Opens the page and returns the title text.

say_en.text: Fill in username and password on the login page and click Log in.
say_en.note: Fills the inputs and clicks the login button.

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot of the current page and save it.
say_en.note: Captures a full-page screenshot to a file.
